Zemu Gap Peak.notable: A subsidiary summit of the Kangchenjunga massif rather than an independent mountain; no known attempts.

Chiumo.notable: No documented ascent; recent attempts have come from the south.

Nanda Khat.notable: Sources give different first-ascent years; 1972 is the most cited.

Chombu.notable: No documented ascent. British attempts in 2019 and 2022 turned back; climbing is tightly controlled near the Tibet border.
